this_week: USMCA 見直し交渉 始動
K-Food上期輸出 過去最高

na.ja: USMCA 6年見直しが始動、代替関税は7/24が期限
na.en: USMCA six-year review begins; fallback tariff sunsets July 24
na.ja_body: 7月1日、USMCAの初の合同見直しが正式に開始。有力シナリオは「修正付き延長」。2月に最高裁がIEEPA関税を無効としたが、政権は通商法122条の10%関税で代替（USMCA適合品は免除）。輸入品全般への15%サーチャージは議会が動かなければ7月24日に失効し、対米輸出食品のコスト前提が今月動く可能性。
na.en_body: The first formal joint review of USMCA began July 1, with 'extension with modifications' the likely outcome. After the Supreme Court voided the IEEPA tariffs in February, the administration substituted a 10% Section 122 tariff (USMCA-compliant goods exempt). The 15% surcharge on imports expires July 24 unless Congress acts — cost assumptions for food exports to the US may shift this month.

na.ja: ウェルネス銘柄争奪、大型統合も前進
na.en: Wellness brands fuel M&A; mega-deals advance
na.ja_body: マコーミックは6月25日、ユニリーバ食品部門買収の統合計画を提示。キャンベルは「Rao's」のLa Regina持分49%取得を完了、SolinaはEpicureanを買収。GLP-1時代を背景にウェルネス系ブランドの争奪が過熱。
na.en_body: McCormick laid out integration plans for its Unilever foods acquisition on June 25. Campbell's completed a 49% stake in La Regina (Rao's), and Solina acquired Epicurean. In the GLP-1 era, competition for wellness brands is heating up.

na.ja: 牛肉+12.9%、コーヒー高が飲料を押し上げ
na.ja_body: 5月の食品CPIは前年比+3.1%、家庭内食品は+2.7%。牛肉は+12.9%と突出（通年見通しは+7.5%へ下方修正）。コーヒー高で飲料は+5.2%予測。卵・乳製品・油脂は下落予測で明暗が鮮明。
na.en_body: May's all-food CPI rose 3.1% and food-at-home 2.7% year on year. Beef stood out at +12.9% (full-year forecast cut to +7.5%). Coffee puts beverages on track for +5.2%, while eggs, dairy and fats should decline — a clear split.

na.ja: GRAS改革へ ─ 自己認証の廃止案
na.ja_body: FDAはGRAS自己認証を廃止し届出を義務化する規則案を年内公表へ。超加工食品（UPF）の連邦定義の提案やナトリウム低減の最終規則も進行中。トレーサビリティ規則の施行は2028年7月へ延期。
na.en_body: The FDA will propose mandatory GRAS notices this year, ending self-affirmation. A federal ultra-processed food (UPF) definition and a sodium-reduction final rule are also in motion. Traceability Rule enforcement slips to July 2028.

na.ja: USDA、中小食肉加工に6,000万ドル
na.en: USDA backs small meat plants with $60M
na.ja_body: USDAは中小食肉加工場の支援策を発表。規制緩和と6,000万ドルの補助金で処理能力拡大を後押しし、食肉供給網の分散化・強靭化を図る。
na.en_body: USDA unveiled support for small meat plants, pairing regulatory relief with $60M in grants to expand capacity and build a more distributed, resilient meat supply chain.

jp.ja: 値上げの夏 ─ 7月2,566品目、パンと即席麺が一斉改定
jp.en: Summer of price hikes: 2,566 items in July, led by bread & noodles
jp.ja_body: 7月の食品値上げは2,566品目と6月（1,078品目）から倍増超え。加工食品1,084品目、パン1,078品目が中心で、山崎製パンは306品目（食パン平均+6.6%）、東洋水産は「赤いきつね」など120品目を改定。要因は原材料高97.7%・物流費74.1%。年間判明分は既に14,902品目で、5年連続の1万品目超えが確定した。
jp.en_body: July food price hikes hit 2,566 items, more than double June's 1,078. Processed foods (1,084) and bread (1,078) led the wave: Yamazaki Baking repriced 306 items (sliced bread +6.6% on average) and Toyo Suisan raised 120 items including Akai Kitsune. Drivers: raw materials (97.7%) and logistics (74.1%). The year-to-date total already stands at 14,902 items — a fifth straight year above 10,000.
jp.src: 出典：帝国データバンク／NHK

jp.ja: 抹茶輸出は10年で7倍、伊藤園はブランド刷新
jp.en: Matcha exports up 7x in a decade; ITO EN rebrands
jp.ja_body: 2025年の粉末状茶（抹茶含む）輸出は603億円と前年（271億円）の2倍超、茶輸出全体の84%を占め過去最高。10年で約7倍に拡大した。飲料市場にも抹茶ブームが波及し、伊藤園は「matcha LOVE」をリブランディングし抹茶ベリーベリーラテなど新商品を投入（公式発表）。一方で原料の碾茶は供給制約と価格高騰が課題に。
jp.en_body: Powdered tea (incl. matcha) exports reached a record ¥60.3B in 2025, more than double the prior year's ¥27.1B and 84% of all tea exports — roughly 7x growth in a decade. The boom is spilling into beverages: ITO EN rebranded its matcha LOVE line and launched new items such as a matcha very-berry latte (per company announcements). Supply constraints and soaring prices for tencha leaf are the emerging challenge.
jp.src: 出典：日本茶輸出促進協議会／食品産業新聞社

jp.ja: 輸出EXPOに世界のバイヤー、ASEANは"普及段階"へ
jp.en: Export EXPO draws global buyers; ASEAN enters adoption phase
jp.ja_body: 6月に東京ビッグサイトで第12回「日本の食品」輸出EXPOが開催され、過去最高の輸出額を背景に抹茶ビジネスの商談が集中。JETROはASEANの日本茶市場が抹茶ブームを経て「本格的な普及段階」に移行したと分析。プレミアム化と現地定番化が同時に進み、和食材の裾野が広がる。
jp.en_body: The 12th 'Japan's Food' Export Fair was held at Tokyo Big Sight in June, with matcha deals in the spotlight amid record export values. JETRO says ASEAN's Japanese tea market has moved past the matcha boom into a full adoption phase. Premiumization and local mainstreaming are advancing together, broadening the base for Japanese ingredients.

kr.ja: 上期輸出62.1億ドルで最高 ─ ラーメン+32%
kr.ja_body: 2026年上期のK-Food+輸出は62.1億ドルで上期として過去最高。ラーメンが5.90億ドル（+32.3%）で単品トップ。激辛チャレンジのバイラル拡散と各社の現地対応新商品が寄与した。農心は釜山に年5億食の輸出専用工場を年央稼働へ、三養食品は中国に初の海外工場を建設中。政府は年間160億ドル目標を維持。
kr.en_body: K-Food+ exports reached $6.21B in H1 2026, a first-half record. Ramyeon led all items at $590.2M (+32.3%), boosted by viral spicy-noodle challenges and locally tailored new products. Nongshim's export-only Busan plant (500M packs/year) starts up mid-year, and Samyang is building its first overseas factory in China. The government holds its $16B full-year target.
kr.src: 出典：韓国農林畜産食品部／Korea Herald

kr.ja: K-コンビニが観光地化、"トゥンバラッテ"拡散
kr.en: K-convenience stores turn tourist spots; 'Ddungbaratte' goes viral
kr.ja_body: 外国人観光客が韓国のコンビニに殺到し、セレブ発の"トゥンバラッテ"（バナナ牛乳アレンジ）がSNSで拡散。三角キンパや即席麺の組み合わせ動画が数百万再生を稼ぐ。冷凍キンパは米国で定番化が進み、韓方（ハンバン）系機能性食品は中東・欧州向け輸出の次の柱に。
kr.en_body: Foreign tourists are flocking to Korean convenience stores, and the celebrity-sparked 'Ddungbaratte' (a banana-milk mix) is spreading on social media. Videos of triangle kimbap and instant-noodle combos rack up millions of views. Frozen kimbap keeps mainstreaming in the US, while hanbang functional foods emerge as the next export pillar toward the Middle East and Europe.

cn.ja: RTD茶が炭酸超え ─ 抹茶生産は日本超えへ
cn.en: RTD tea passes soda; matcha output rivals Japan
cn.ja_body: 中国飲料市場（小売2,200〜2,500億ドル規模）で、RTD茶が初めて炭酸飲料を抜き第2位に。新商品の45%超が低糖・機能性訴求で、機能性飲料は年10〜12%成長。抹茶では中国の生産量が年5,000〜6,000トン規模に達し、日本に匹敵・凌駕する水準との推計も。世界の抹茶供給地図が塗り替わりつつある。
cn.en_body: In China's beverage market (retail value $220–250B), RTD tea overtook carbonated drinks for the first time to become the No.2 segment. Over 45% of new launches carry low-sugar or functional claims, with functional beverages growing 10–12% a year. In matcha, China's output has reached an estimated 5,000–6,000 tons annually — rivaling or surpassing Japan — redrawing the global matcha supply map.

cn.ja: 蜜雪6万店の調達網、健康×新奇の実験続く
cn.ja_body: 店舗数世界最大（約6万店）の蜜雪冰城はASEAN展開に加えブラジル1号店とコーヒー豆・果実の輸入拡大を計画。重慶ではレモン農園3.8万ムーを支援し農薬30%減を実現。即席麺では白象がケール麺を発売、低価格帯市場は26年に712億元へ。人口の85%とされる乳糖不耐を背景にラクトースフリー乳製品も伸長。
cn.en_body: Mixue, the world's largest food-service chain by stores (~60,000), plans its first Brazil store and expanded imports of coffee beans and fruit alongside its ASEAN push; in Chongqing it supports 38,000 mu of lemon orchards, cutting pesticide use 30%. In noodles, Baixiang launched a kale ramen as the value segment heads to ¥71.2B by 2026. With ~85% of the population lactose intolerant, lactose-free dairy keeps growing.
